verdict.rationale: Cooley shows an international venture footprint: offices in London, Brussels, Singapore, Hong Kong and mainland China, UK and Singapore versions of the YC Safe generator, a UK NDA form, a France practice page, and a claimed global #1 ranking for companies raising VC. However, nothing explicitly documents cross-border venture matters such as flips, redomiciliations or multi-jurisdiction financings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of flips/redomiciliations, described multi-jurisdiction financing work or international-investor deal experience, and independent corroboration of cross-border venture work.
